description:
A little slice of old Hollywood 🌴
This Hollywood Regency palm tree floor lamp is pure statement - sculptural, glamorous and unapologetically bold. Gilded leaves, warm golden glow and all the drama you want from a piece that doesn’t whisper. Available online now.
